title: MineJourney SMP
description: EN: A build by one of the players (_Fennec25) from the private server MineJourney. Improves vanilla visuals and includes useful mods for building, such as Litematic and World Edit.
body:
EN:
A build by one of the players (_Fennec25) from the private server MineJourney.
Improves vanilla visuals and includes useful mods for building, such as Litematic and World Edit.
RU:
Сборка одного из игроков (_Fennec25) с приватного сервера MineJourney.
Улучшает ванильный визуал, имеет полезные моды для строительства, такие как Litematic и World Edit
